semiconductor_relevance: High — Lintec Advanced Technologies specializes in manufacturing equipment and materials specifically designed for semiconductor applications, particularly in adhesive technologies.
summary: Lintec Advanced Technologies (Singapore) Pte Ltd is a leading manufacturer of pressure-sensitive adhesive tapes and related equipment for the semiconductor industry. Their product offerings include dicing tape, BG tape, and fully-automatic equipment for wafer mounting and UV irradiation, aimed at enhancing productivity in semiconductor production processes.
capabilities: Dicing tape and BG tape for semiconductor applications

regional_presence.Singapore: Lintec Advanced Technologies operates in Singapore, focusing on the semiconductor market with a range of specialized products.
